dataset: Zenodo 4245091 = Farnes et al PLOS ONE (Dryad), spontaneous EEGLAB .set
critical_finding: Zenodo 4245091 is NOT the Sarasso ketamine TMS-EEG the spec named. It is the Farnes resting-state dataset with ONLY eyes-open / eyes-closed labels — no ketamine/wake contrast exists. The original S20/ketamine hypothesis is UNTESTABLE from this DOI.
method: LZ76 median-binarize, 16 ch, central 60s, downsample to ~128 Hz, n=5 EO + 5 EC subjects
hypothesis_substituted: LZ_eyesOpen != LZ_eyesClosed (eyes-closed alpha -> expected lower complexity)
note: No significant eyes-open vs eyes-closed LZ76 difference at toy scale (t=0.63, n=5/5). EC trends slightly HIGHER, opposite the naive alpha->lower-complexity expectation, but not significant. Dataset is wrong for the intended ketamine hypothesis anyway. Honest null.
